RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Interpreter of Japanese Military Police in Possession of a Revolver.

At 9 p.m. 9-11-32 C.D.C. 199 whilst walking along Hupeh Road observed two men one Japanese and one Chinese walking in a suspicious manner. On being searched Japanese was found in possession of a .32 revolver No.36180 "Johnson" and a pair of hand cuffs. Whilst the detective was busy in searching, a male Chinese absconded.

The Japanese who gave his name as Yenkichi Harayama, member of Japanese Military Police at 2 Kiangwan Road.

By J.D.C.131 Iguchi and the undersigned he was escorted to the Japanese Consulate where the Military Police were called. He was identified as the interpreter attached to the Japanese Military Police.

On being questioned he stated that he was ordered by Major Hase to make enquiries into the activities of communists in Chapei and was with a member of the Public Safety Bureau (name unknown) when arrested.

He also admitted that he had no license for the revolver and that the same was given to him by some one during the trouble a few months ago.

He was handed over to Sgt. Kawamura of J.M.P., the revolver and handcuffs are kept at the station and to be returned to some competent authority.

日本宪兵队翻译持有左轮手枪案。

1932年11月9日晚9时，刑事侦缉处警员199号在湖北路行走时，发现两名男子，一名日本人，一名中国人，行迹可疑。经搜查，发现该日本人持有一支“.32”口径、编号为36180的“约翰逊”（Johnson）牌左轮手枪及一副手铐。当侦探忙于搜查时，那名中国男子逃遁。

该日本人自称原山延吉（Yenkichi Harayama，音译），系江湾路2号日本宪兵队成员。

经日本领事馆巡捕131号井口（Iguchi，音译）及本人押送至日本领事馆，并召来宪兵队人员。其身份被确认为日本宪兵队附属翻译。

经讯问，他声称奉长谷川（Hase，音译）少校之命，调查闸北地区的共产党活动，被捕时正与一名公共安全局（Public Safety Bureau）成员（姓名不详）在一起。

他还承认没有该左轮手枪的持枪执照，并称该枪是数月前动乱期间由某人交给他的。

他已被移交给日本宪兵队川村（Kawamura，音译）军士，左轮手枪和手铐暂存于捕房，待归还给有关主管当局。
